title: TD Cowen: Democratic Sweep Makes a Crypto-Backed CLARITY Act ‘Impossible’
summary: Bitcoin Magazine TD Cowen: Democratic Sweep Makes a Crypto-Backed CLARITY Act ‘Impossible’ The Democratic sweep and Sherrod Brown’s return may kill the CLARITY Act for two years and may make any industry-backed version impossible as Democrats investigate Trump’s crypto ties, TD Cowen analysts write. This post TD Cowen: Democratic Sweep Makes a Crypto-Backed CLARITY Act ‘Impossible’ first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
